rationale: The agent appears to have executed order-changing writes (address change, laptop item change, and watch exchange) via tool calls without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Although the agent likely identified the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip) and accessed the user’s own orders, there’s no visible confirmation step prior to modify_pending_order_address, modify_pending_order_items, or exchange_delivered_order_items. The final message is also inconsistent—it claims to have updated the order and only clarified the exchange process, despite tool calls indicating an exchange was performed. The agent did not clearly present or verify the specifics requested (e.g., black dial with leather strap, confirming the correct laptop SKU 9844888101) nor confirm the NYC address from profile before writing. Therefore, it fails the stated policy requirements.
